title: Class 6 Science · Ch 3 Worksheet C · Deficiency Diseases
instructions: Identify common deficiency diseases and their cures.

questions.question: Scurvy is caused by deficiency of
Anaemia is caused by deficiency of
questions.explanation: Iron deficiency reduces haemoglobin in blood.

questions.question: _____ deficiency in children causes weak, soft bones — a disease called rickets.
questions.explanation: Vitamin D + calcium are needed for healthy bones.

questions.question: _____ deficiency causes goitre, a swelling of the thyroid gland in the neck.
Eating spinach with a slice of lemon is good for an anaemic child.
questions.explanation: Spinach has iron; vitamin C in lemon helps absorb it.

questions.question: A child has bleeding gums and feels tired. Which deficiency might she have, and what foods would you suggest?
questions.answer: This sounds like vitamin C deficiency (scurvy). Suggest foods like orange, lemon, amla, guava, tomato — all rich in vitamin C.
questions.explanation: Tests linking symptom to deficiency to food.

questions.question: A village has many cases of goitre. Suggest one practical change the community can make and explain why it helps.
questions.answer: Use iodised salt in cooking and at the table. Iodine is added to the salt in tiny amounts. Daily use over weeks raises iodine levels and prevents goitre.
questions.explanation: Tests applying nutrition knowledge to a community problem.

questions.question: Design a small poster (in words) titled 'Food for Strong Bones'. Include three messages and three foods to recommend.
questions.answer: Sample. Title: Food for Strong Bones. Messages: (1) Drink milk every day for calcium. (2) Spend 20 minutes in the morning sun for vitamin D. (3) Eat green vegetables like methi or palak. Foods to recommend: Milk and curd; ragi (finger millet); leafy greens like methi/palak. Any creative, accurate poster accepted.
